title: Sharity project overview
content: Sharity is a marketplace project for buyers and sellers. Locally implemented flows include listing discovery, seller listing drafts and moderation submission, cart, single-listing purchase review and order status. These are local development capabilities, not verified live production features. Payments are gated demo transactions by default; real payment processing is not verified. Multi-item checkout, shipping fulfillment, digital delivery and full disputes/refunds remain incomplete or require end-to-end validation.

title: Approved public technology summary
content: The Sharity source uses Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Security OAuth2/OIDC, REST microservices, SQL persistence, an Expo React Native Web frontend and GitHub Actions. Service responsibilities include authorization, browser BFF, marketplace, payment, wallet and AI. Sharity AI uses Spring AI with a privately hosted Ollama Qwen3 model through Spring AI. Authentication uses OAuth2/OIDC through the browser BFF. These statements describe the inspected project, not a verified employment or personal skills history. Internal service addresses, deployment configuration, credentials and account data are not public knowledge.
